articles.title: Volunteers Turn Out for the Winter Cleanup Across Lower Millrace
articles.deck: Residents of Lower Millrace filled the hall on Monday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Gwen Gilroy, who has lived in Lower Millrace for 13 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The plan calls for book exchange box along Garden Avenue, with work expected to start in December.
Public works estimates the work will take about 13 weeks once it begins. The Lower Millrace Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.

articles.title: Parish and Park Groups Team Up on Sidewalk Ramp
articles.deck: Residents of Foundry Row filled the hall on Saturday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Leona Thibodeaux, who has lived in Foundry Row for 23 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The Foundry Row Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.
The plan calls for sidewalk ramp along Hollis Drive, with work expected to start in September. Public works estimates the work will take about 23 weeks once it begins.
Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Saturday mornings. The group has raised $48,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Community Garden
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting.
